title: Artifact catalog (the artifacts manifest)
description: The manifest of standalone analysis artifacts (issue #14). Each artifact is a self-contained deliverable rendered under analysis/artifacts/<id>/ with a catalog STUB describing it. This file (analysis/artifacts/catalog.json) lists every stub so the portal and the brain can enumerate artifacts without crawling the directory. An artifact is the generic escape hatch for any bespoke deliverable — a golden record, an identity strategy, a timeline, an integration catalog — that does not fit one of the first-class authoring tools: a stub (catalog metadata) + canonical data JSON + an index.html render. AUTHORED, not derived: hand-write the stub + its data + render, then list the stub here. Feeds the gen-brain.py `artifacts` adapter (Catalog/Artifact nodes + in_catalog edges + relates_to edges to referenced sessions).

artifact.description: One catalog stub: the metadata for a standalone artifact. The render itself lives at `href`; the canonical data lives beside it under analysis/artifacts/<id>/.

id.description: Stable slug — also the directory name under analysis/artifacts/.

icon.description: Short glyph or mono label shown on the artifact card.

href.description: Relative path to the render (e.g. artifacts/<id>/index.html).

updated.description: ISO date the artifact was last revised.

type.description: Artifact category — e.g. design, catalog, tracker, timeline, strategy.

source_sessions.description: Session ids the artifact was distilled from; the brain links the artifact to each via a relates_to edge.
